title: First-selection style picker: Kit, Accent, Register and Look chosen with the theme seed the site
detail:
When an owner first picks a theme, they choose Kit, Accent, Register (Night/Day) and optionally a Look. That choice seeds preferences.siteStyle and the kit's pages, so the editor opens already looking like it. Built on ThemeControls and the dial registry, theme-agnostic: every converted theme gets it. Theme fence: the picker preview renders only the stand-alone site surface.

Pick your look: a never-saved website opens on one sheet (theme, accent, Night or Day, look, starter kit, home page canvas), each pick through the Theme tab's handlers; Theme tab row reopens it. Daniel approved the compact mock 2026-11-04.
